name: Chromaggus
source: [logs: Anniversary] Melee 2,513 to 4,161 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 1.37 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 21 kills on the Anniversary Hardcore realms (Normal, 2025-03-31 to 2025-07-31): the median of 793 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (3,280), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (793 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 2,052 weapon damage, spread 0.803, a 1.14 s swing. Length: the kills' length, median 115 s (10th to 90th percentile 91 to 184). Abilities: Two breaths a lockout, one at 30 s and one at 60 s, each every 60 s (the vmangos script). Incinerate 23308 3,675 to 4,725 Fire, Corrosive Acid 23313 875 to 1,125 Nature every 3 s for 15 s (and 3,938 to 5,062 less armor), the Classic Era client's spell data.

notes: Picks Incinerate and Corrosive Acid of the five breaths. Corrosive Acid's armor cut isn't modelled. Frenzy (+150% attack speed every 15 s) is in the logs' swing rate, as much of it as the raids let through. Brood Afflictions on the raid are the healing sim's.

healing.notes: From the Anniversary Hardcore realms's logs (21 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 8 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 2,425 a second with overheal and absorbs (31% of the heals effective), 2.60 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 766 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (1% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Warrior 20, Druid 1.

raidHealing.notes: What the Anniversary Hardcore realms raids had on Chromaggus (21 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 40 with 1 tanks (0 of them on adds, who took 0 a second together, not in the events), 11 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (94% of the healing), each 267 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 1,171 a second (724 on the tanks, 417 on the rest, 49% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 8.6 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.
